title: Alcove units either side of a chimney breast
summary: Full-height shelving in one alcove, shelves over a cupboard in the other.
intro: A living room with a cast-iron fireplace and two empty alcoves. One side became full-height shelving, the other shelves over a two-door cupboard. Both are lined and built in MDF and run right up to the cornice, so they look like they were always there.
